description: RME TotalMix FX 2.x: scalable, Direct3D 12 mixer and routing console for RME interfaces. The installer can also install the classic 1.991 build.
notes: NOT unattended: RME's TotalMix FX Install Wizard is interactive and requires UAC elevation. It lets you choose version 2.x or 1.991.
Requires an RME driver to be installed first ('rme-fireface-usb-driver' or 'rme-madiface-driver'). Those drivers already bundle TotalMix FX 1.991, so you only need this package for 2.x.
TotalMix FX 2.x requires Windows 10 or newer and a Direct3D 12 capable GPU.
To switch between 2.x and 1.991 later, run '$dir\TMInstaller.exe' again.
